properties.name: correlationKey
properties.description: Key, used to correlate a message subscription with the message.

properties.name: expirationTimer
properties.description: A timer defines a point in time using a time value, a CRON expression or a duration.

properties.name: timeCycle
properties.description: CRON expression that specifies a cyclic timer.

properties.name: timeDuration
properties.description: Duration based timer that uses the engine's time to calculate a point in time.

properties.name: uniqueKey
properties.description: Optional key that uniquely identifies the message. If a message with the same name, correlation key and unique key exists, the message is discarded.

properties.name: variables
properties.description: Variables to set or delete at process instance scope. For a variable deletion, no data must be provided.

items.description: ProcessVariable represents a variable at process instance scope.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Data is used to store any data within an engine.

properties.name: encoding
properties.description: Encoding of the value - e.g. json.

properties.name: encrypted
properties.description: Determines if a value is encrypted before it is stored.

properties.name: workerId
properties.description: ID of the worker that sent the message.
